answer_1.quote: We study different ranking losses unified under the LiPO framework on the popular Reddit TL;DR summarization  and AnthropicHH dialogue  datasets, and provide further verification on OpenAssistant dataset in Section 5.4.

answer_2.quote: Proxy Reward Model computes the relative win rate of generated response against SFT target over the SFT validation split on the trained T5-XXL pairwise reward-ranking model.

answer_3.quote: AutoSxS computes the relative win rate of generated response against SFT target over the SFT validation split using large instruction tuned model (PaLM 2-L-IT)  via few-shot in-context learning

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation asks human raters to assign an absolute quality score on each response and determine the relatively best one among DPO BT , DPO PL (PRO) and LiPOλ
